rules: Event identity is server-assigned; original facts self-root, derived control events preserve rootEventId and bind causationEventId to their immutable source event.
Each owner writes its domain fact and owner-local Outbox record atomically, publishes with a lease and broker acknowledgement, and claims at-least-once rather than exactly-once delivery.

Each consumer atomically commits its owner-local effect and dedupe receipt before offset commit; retry is bounded and classified, DLQ preserves original lineage, and replay uses the same consumer path.

Ordering is aggregate-scoped and gaps or stale versions defer or reconcile rather than silently apply; workflow coordinates Saga and compensation without foreign-schema writes, Kafka RPC or distributed 2PC.
Manual recovery binds an immutable action digest, server-derived requester and independent approver, pre/post reconciliation, audit correlation and a closure receipt before CLOSED.
Static policy, generated schemas, tests and B26 candidates cannot promote M2 runtime status or release readiness.

The independent reliability gate did not delegate the complete event-governance checks, allowing producer, dataOwner, publish/subscribe operation, payload reference, governance status or correlation drift; the Outbox PUBLISHED schema also allowed attempt zero. Commit 6ce98a9 closed these bypasses.
All current-source P1/P2 findings are closed; the final review accepted the D2 contract and retained every static/runtime boundary.
